title: CR-Bench-v2: Evaluating the Real-World Utility of AI Code Review Agents
title_zh: CR-Bench-v2：评估AI代码审查智能体的真实世界效用

paragraphs.en: 提出CR-Bench-v2代码审查基准，最强AI智能体也仅能检出约三分之一的已知缺陷。 The rapid growth of automated code generation has created a pressing need for automated code review. Yet code review resists full automation: it depends on context beyond the \textit{diff}, on the author's intent, and on judgments about design and maintainability on which even expert reviewers disagree. Existing code review benchmarks lack standardization and rely largely on noisy human review comments scored with text-similarity metrics, which reward surface overlap and fail to measure precision. We introduce \texttt{CR-Bench}, a defect-centric evaluation framework that recasts SWE-Bench issues as pull-request review tasks with full repository context. After filtering for review-detectable defects and grounding each to a single originating pull request, \texttt{CR-Bench} contains 584 instances, with a 174-instance \texttt{CR-Bench-Verified} subset derived from SWE-Bench Verified. Each instance pairs a pull request with a known defect, its ground-truth fix, and a taxonomy label for bug category, impact, and severity. We propose two complementary metrics: \emph{Known-Defect Detection Rate} (KDDR), which measures whether an agent identifies the labeled defect, and \emph{Usefulness Rate}, which measures the fraction of review comments that are actionable. We evaluate eight code review agents over four backbones, plus commercially available Gemini Code Assist, using three independent LLM judges. Even the strongest systems detect only about one-third of known defects (KDDR $\approx$ 33\%), and Gemini Code Assist detects 8.1\%.
paragraphs.zh: 提出CR-Bench-v2代码审查基准，最强AI智能体也仅能检出约三分之一的已知缺陷。 自动代码生成的快速增长催生了对自动化代码审查的迫切需求。 然而代码审查难以完全自动化：它依赖于\textit{diff}之外的上下文、作者意图，以及对设计与可维护性的判断，而即便是专家评审者对这些判断也存在分歧。 现有代码审查基准缺乏标准化，且主要依赖含噪的人类评审意见，并用文本相似度指标进行评分，这类指标奖励表面上的重叠，无法衡量精确率。 我们提出\texttt{CR-Bench}，一个以缺陷为中心的评估框架，它将SWE-Bench问题重构为具有完整仓库上下文的拉取请求审查任务。 经过筛选仅保留可通过审查发现的缺陷，并将每个缺陷对应到唯一的原始拉取请求后，\texttt{CR-Bench}包含584个实例，其中包含源自SWE-Bench Verified的174个实例的\texttt{CR-Bench-Verified}子集。 每个实例将一个包含已知缺陷的拉取请求与其真值修复方案以及缺陷类别、影响和严重程度的分类标签配对。 我们提出两个互补的指标：\emph{已知缺陷检出率}（KDDR），衡量智能体是否识别出被标注的缺陷；以及\emph{有用率}，衡量评审意见中可执行意见的比例。 我们基于四种骨干模型评估了八个代码审查智能体，外加商用Gemini Code Assist，并使用三个独立的LLM裁判。 即使是最强的系统也只能检出约三分之一的已知缺陷（KDDR $\approx$ 33\%），而Gemini Code Assist的检出率为8.1\%。
